accuracy: Holovator pins are owner-surveyed approximate research areas, not proved exact door pixels. Sector entries lack point geometry. No invented interior layouts or roof connections. No moving DLC portals permanently pinned.

holovators.name: Vert Sector 4 — central Café Classe
holovators.directions: Inside the enclosed grassy Vert Sector 4 courtyard behind Café Classe, find the central golden Holovator beside the large dark scaffold panels. The ground photo shows barred lower windows and geometric window frames. Published guides approach this courtyard from the surrounding roofs; do not assume there is a direct street-level entrance. Use the separate south street lift or the published Café Classe rooftop approach to begin.

holovators.name: Vert Sector 4 — eastern lift
holovators.directions: Once inside the enclosed grassy courtyard behind Café Classe, head toward its eastern building frontage. The golden Holovator is against a long pale stone wall with blue shutters. Independent rooftop guides describe returning to roof level using the courtyard's eastern lift. The owner's ground and arrival photographs support the location type, not a measured roof landing or an independently certified connection between all three lifts.

holovators.name: Vernal Avenue / Wild Zone 1
holovators.directions: From the Pokémon Research Lab or the northwest corner of Wild Zone 1, head onto Vernal Avenue to the recessed Holovator by the building wall. After battling Taunie/Urbain during Main Mission 10, speak to Terra for Side Mission 023: Underneath the Holovator. Investigate the dirt mound in front of the lift and defeat or catch the Lv. 28 Diggersby to restore rooftop access. The map point is an approximate surveyed approach, not an exact doorway pixel.

holovators.name: Bleu Sector 7 — South Boulevard
holovators.directions: From Bleu Pokémon Center, head southeast onto South Boulevard along Bleu Sector 7's southern frontage, near Nouveau Café (Truck No. 2). Find maintenance worker Durstin beside the faulty Holovator. After beginning Main Mission 19, give him Fresh Water, Soda Pop, Lemonade or Moomoo Milk for Side Mission 045: On Maintenance Duty; he repairs the lift and opens the rooftop route. This five-photo owner-surveyed map location remains an approximate approach, not a certified door or roof coordinate.

holovators.name: Bleu Sector 8 — Café Soleil
holovators.directions: From Café Soleil, head southeast down the outer South Boulevard to the southwest frontage of Bleu Sector 8. The five owner photographs show a gold triple-chevron Holovator against blue-glass windows, near a worker and a street-side grass strip, followed by a rooftop arrival. Side Mission 092 The Beldum Blockade and requester Aimant occur in this same South Boulevard neighbourhood; however, this photographed physical lift has NOT been individually verified as the exact mission device. Use the in-game quest marker to find the group of four Beldum. Its 1920px map XY is an approximate survey lead, not a certified ground door, roof landing or precise item point.

holovators.name: Espace Vide / Bleu Sector 4
holovators.directions: From Café Rouleau follow Estival Avenue toward Espace Vide; the lift is by the modern dark-glazed building at the northwest edge of Bleu Sector 4.

holovators.name: Café Gallant — Estival Avenue
holovators.directions: From Espace Vide continue northeast along Estival Avenue toward Café Gallant, looking along the northern building frontage for the gold chevrons.

holovators.name: Magenta Plaza — northwestern terrace
holovators.directions: From Magenta Plaza walk to the curved northwest edge. Take the broad staircase on the right of the raised café terrace to reach the lift.

holovators.name: Magenta Sector 8 — Saison Canal
holovators.directions: From the Magenta Sector 8 Pokémon Center stay on the north bank of Saison Canal, following Magenta Street east toward the Lumiose Sewers travel marker.

holovators.name: Lysandre Café — Autumnal Avenue
holovators.directions: From Lysandre Café walk northeast along the WEST side of Autumnal Avenue to a blue Lumi Cab and the yellow triple-chevron Holovator against the grey building wall. These five owner photographs document this ground lift and rooftop arrival in the Magenta Sector 2 neighbourhood. Chuckie's Side Mission 071 and its catchable Lv. 50 Alpha Watchog are nearby, but this photographed lift has NOT been independently proven to be the exact quest device. Use the in-game quest marker for Chuckie; this is an approximate owner-surveyed map point, not an exact mission entrance or rooftop coordinate.

holovators.name: Rouge Plaza — Sommi's lift
holovators.directions: From Rouge Plaza, head west of Wild Zone 3 to the pale building with blue shutters. After starting Main Mission 6, speak to worker Sommi beside the broken red Holovator for Side Mission 004: A Break Time Battle. Defeat his Pidgey Lv. 8, Budew Lv. 8 and Emolga Lv. 10; Sommi repairs the lift and you can reach the roof. The map point is an approximate surveyed approach, not an exact doorway pixel.

holovators.name: Looker Bureau / Sushi High Roller
holovators.directions: From the north side of Rouge Plaza head toward Looker Bureau. Find the lift on the west building wall across the short north-south street from Sushi High Roller, south of Dormez Bien Cemetery.

holovators.name: North Boulevard — Rouge Sector 3
holovators.directions: From the northwestern inner city, use Wild Zone 18 and Wild Zone 13 as map bearings. Inspect the long building frontage just inside North Boulevard for the gold lift.

holovators.name: East of Sushi High Roller
holovators.directions: Continue east from Sushi High Roller along the south edge of Dormez Bien Cemetery. Before the Hibernal Avenue junction find the gold lift along the building frontage.

holovators.name: Jaune Sector 7 — Hibernal Avenue
holovators.directions: Follow Hibernal Avenue northeast from Café Kizuna toward Café Ultimo. The separate lift is against the east/right building frontage.

holovators.name: Jaune Sector 4 — Académie Étoile
holovators.directions: From the Pokémon Center northeast of Académie Étoile, follow Hibernal Avenue southwest to the triangular Jaune Sector 4 building. Find the arrows by the blue windows.

holovators.name: Jaune Sector 11 — Jaune Street
holovators.directions: From Jaune Plaza follow Jaune Street east toward North Boulevard. Just south of Wild Zone 19 find the raised stone terrace against the grey-blue window building, beside a blond trainer.

holovators.name: Inside Wild Zone 6 — North Boulevard
holovators.directions: Enter Wild Zone 6 from North Boulevard near Café Bataille. Look for the gold chevrons on the building frontage. Wild Houndour and Houndoom attack nearby: protect your team while reaching the lift.

holovators.name: Café Cyclone — concealed courtyard
holovators.directions: At Café Cyclone near Coulant Waterway, enter the broad covered stone archway. Walk into the grassy inner courtyard. The permanent gold Holovator is on the far wall. Use it to reach the green-panelled rooftop.

The gold lift is by the far wall; the rooftop arrival is pictured, but the exact roof exit on the overview map is not measured.

holovators.name: My Favorite Holovator — Bleu Sector 3
holovators.directions: From Bleu Plaza by Wild Zone 16, walk southeast into Bleu Sector 3 and stay north of Aymlis Park (Wild Zone 12). Look for the small paved courtyard on the southwest side of the building, west of Café Woof. The permanent gold triple-chevron lift stands by the wall beside a city information worker. You do not need to enter the Wild Zone. During Side Mission #61, a guarding trainer may need to be beaten before use.

The upper roof's exact map coordinate and floor remain unverified.

holovators.name: Café Classe south — Vernal Pokémon Center
holovators.directions: From the Vernal Avenue Pokémon Center, go to Café Classe by the east edge of Aymlis Park. Find the stationary gold-chevron Holovator on the east-side street-facing building wall immediately south of the café. Approach from the public street, without entering Wild Zone 12; this is NOT the central Café Classe or eastern Vert Sector 4 lift.

The Investigate prompt is a separate interaction; exact upper roof XY and floor are not established.

ladders.name: Hotel Z courtyard ladder
ladders.directions: Stand outside Hotel Z facing its entrance doors. Go to the RIGHT side of the hotel into the narrow enclosed courtyard/alley. Follow the wall past shrubs to the tall metal ladder. Climb up to reach the rooftop approach.

routes.title: Vert Sector 7 — Élec's lift and rooftop Screw (#40)
routes.description: Independent quest and rooftop guides establish the route sequence. The exact physical lift, door and roof landing are not yet matched to our owner photos. This is a written route, not a new map pin.

steps.title: Start at Vert Pokémon Center
steps.instruction: Head northeast along South Boulevard toward the station-side frontage of Vert Sector 7. The disabled lift is near Élec.

steps.title: Unlock the request
steps.instruction: After winning the Canari Quiz Whiz during Main Mission 14, speak to Élec for Side Mission 40.

steps.title: Restore the lift
steps.instruction: Target the disabled Holovator and hit it with an Electric-type move. Complete the request before trying to ascend.

steps.title: Ascend and find the roof bridge
steps.instruction: Use the repaired lift. A published Screw route leads ahead across a leaf bridge and then turns right along the roof.

steps.title: Look for the Colorful Screw
steps.instruction: Check the far end of that rooftop, near the northeastern corner of the complex southeast of the grassy area. Our original numbered Screw clue and its exact pickup pixel have not yet been reconciled with this route.

steps.title: Check the remaining geometry
steps.instruction: Exact doorway, roof arrival, bridge endpoints and pickup positions still require an in-game survey. No exact pin or new collection checkbox is claimed.

routes.title: Jaune Sector 6 — Médierà's lift and rooftop finds (#56)
routes.description: Follow corroborated mission directions and an independently reported rooftop lead. A named sector is not an exact lift location; the device and landing coordinates are still awaiting a field survey.

steps.title: Start from Wild Zone 8
steps.instruction: Take the streets southwest from Wild Zone 8, then turn southeast toward Jaune Sector 6 and the mission marker.

steps.title: Find Médierà
steps.instruction: Speak to Médierà beside the disabled lift for Side Mission 56. Sources place availability around the Rank D victory in Main Mission 19 and the transition to Main Mission 20.

steps.title: Use a physical Fighting-type attack
steps.instruction: Target the Holovator with a physical Fighting-type move, such as Rock Smash. A special-category or status move will not complete the request.

steps.title: Explore the reopened rooftop
steps.instruction: Ride the restored lift. GameWith reports a Wild Charge TM and wild Larvitar in the rooftop area. Look for them in-game; neither has a measured Atlas pickup or spawn coordinate.

steps.title: Check the roof landing
steps.instruction: We still need ground and roof photographs and independent map registration. No exact new doorway, roof, item or Pokémon pin has been placed.

routes.title: Vert Sector 4 — Café Classe courtyard, Ralts and three Screws
routes.description: Independent guides describe a roof-to-courtyard route, courtyard lifts and two scaffold pickup heights. Our three distinct photographed Holovators are useful orientation references. Their exact roof connections and individual pickup pixels are not yet measured. Treat the pickup steps as separate optional destinations, not a fully surveyed walking path.

steps.title: Start at Vernal Pokémon Center
steps.instruction: Go toward Café Classe on Vernal Avenue, by the east side of Aymlis Park. Published routes start using the street-side Holovator in this neighbourhood. Compare the original south-lift photo for the public street frontage; the exact guide-to-photo device identity is not independently certified.

steps.title: Reach the enclosed courtyard from above
steps.instruction: Ascend to the surrounding roofs and look into the large grassy courtyard behind Café Classe. Descend into the enclosed area rather than searching for an assumed street-level doorway. Ralts and Bunnelby are reported in this yard.

steps.title: Identify the two internal lifts
steps.instruction: The original central-lift photograph shows the golden chevrons beside dark scaffold panels; the eastern-lift photograph shows a long blue-shuttered stone frontage. These are distinct courtyard lifts. Guides also report a ladder near the café, but its precise base and exit remain unregistered.

steps.title: Rooftop Screw — original clue #8
steps.instruction: Use the eastern courtyard lift to return to the roofs. Follow the rooftop toward the northwest and look for the rooftop Screw; guides describe this as the easier of the three local pickups. The item-to-source route numbering matches the roof clue, but no exact pixel or guaranteed roof crossing has been surveyed.

steps.title: Two scaffold Screws — original clues #6 and #7
steps.instruction: Return to the roof overlooking the courtyard's scaffold structures. The lower and upper tiers each contain a Screw. Plan separate descents, using Roto-Glide to land at the intended platform height. Some guides report difficult running-roll alternatives, so Glide is recommended rather than asserted mandatory for both Screws. Match each purple pickup to its tier before marking the original clue complete.

steps.title: Optional TM033 Body Slam
steps.instruction: A golden TM pickup is reported on a platform in the same courtyard scaffold course. Use Roto-Glide after it becomes available in Main Mission 16 to reach the platform. This is a separate pickup from the two purple Screw balls; its exact platform and landing XY remain unmeasured.

steps.title: Remaining field checks
steps.instruction: The three photographed lifts have approximate existing approach positions. The separate ladder, scaffold entrances, precise roof exits and all collectible pixels still need independent visual registration. No new fixed pin is claimed.

routes.title: Vert Sector 5 — two scaffold courses and TM001 Headbutt
routes.description: Two distinct scaffold Screw locations are reported: the grassy plaza northwest of Hotel Z and the enclosed building courtyard. Follow these as separate optional approaches. Original Atlas clues #1 and #5 are possible counterparts; their individual map marker identities still need visual alignment. Neither is a new collection entry.

steps.title: Orient between Vert Plaza and Hotel Z
steps.instruction: Vert Sector 5 is east of Vert Sector 4 and south of Vert Plaza (Wild Zone 2). Use Hotel Z and the nearby waterway as bearings. This sector view is for orientation, not an exact scaffold entrance.

steps.title: Grassy plaza scaffold
steps.instruction: Find the park northwest of Hotel Z. Begin at the accessible ramp of the scaffold course and follow the platforms and narrow bridges upward to the purple Screw pickup. The northwest-Hotel-Z clue #1 is a likely match, not a certified individual marker. A guide describes this course without a Glide requirement.

steps.title: Separate enclosed courtyard scaffold
steps.instruction: Look within the larger building complex, rather than the open grassy plaza. The other Screw is reported in a recessed platform of the courtyard scaffolding. Climb to an upper level and plan a controlled drop with Roto-Glide to the lower opening. Original clue #5 is a likely candidate; its exact pickup position is not measured.

steps.title: Alternative approach from Vert Sector 4
steps.instruction: A separate walkthrough reports a route from the Vert 4 courtyard Holovator over successive green rooftops to a pipe-lined wall, then down to a scaffold with a ladder. From there it reports further short scaffold crossings. This is a source-described alternative, not a verified connection to our photographed lift or a guaranteed early-game no-Glide route.

steps.title: Optional TM001 Headbutt
steps.instruction: From the southern side of Vert Plaza, follow the riverside toward the eastern side of Vert Sector 5's larger building complex. Clear the boulders with Rock Smash and collect the golden TM ball at the end of the path. This ground-level pickup is separate from the scaffold Screws.

steps.title: Main Mission 16 rooftop access
steps.instruction: For the story route, start with the separately documented Hotel Z courtyard ladder. During Main Mission 16, meet Urbain or Taunie on the rooftops to learn Roto-Glide, then follow the rooftop and web-bridge approach toward Rogue Mega Beedrill. Complete the encounter for Beedrillite. This is not a verified link between the two Screw scaffolds.

steps.title: Remaining alignment checks
steps.instruction: Two local Screw locations are corroborated, but their source marker-to-original-clue mapping, ladder bases, scaffold tiers and roof crossing endpoints are not yet registered on our original map. No new exact pin or new collectible checkbox is claimed.

routes.title: Vert Sector 6 — Racine Construction, Le Nah and rooftop TMs
routes.description: Separate optional approaches around Racine Construction, Restaurant Le Nah and South Boulevard. Original Screw clues #19–22 are retained. Four source pickup coordinates are recorded in the research register, but are not calibrated Atlas pixels or ladder entrances. These are written directions, not a certified continuous route.

steps.title: Start outside Racine Construction
steps.instruction: Find the construction company on South Boulevard in Vert Sector 6. The worker outside exchanges Colorful Screws for Canari plush bonuses. Use the construction frontage and park as landmarks; the district map view is approximate.

steps.title: Indoor Screw #19 and Canari reward
steps.instruction: When story access permits, enter the building and inspect the lobby behind the front desk for the purple Screw pickup. TM066 Volt Switch is different: Canari awards it after her Rank E promotion battle during Main Mission 15. It is not a rooftop TM or another Screw.

steps.title: Park-side scaffold — clues #20–21
steps.instruction: Look behind Racine Construction toward the park between the company and Restaurant Le Nah. Follow the rising scaffold platforms to roof height, then drop onto the platform holding the purple pickup. This is one of the two nearby scaffold clues #20–21; the individual clue, entrance and tier are not yet matched.

steps.title: South Boulevard scaffold — clues #20–21
steps.instruction: Check the separate tall roadside scaffolding north of Racine Construction. Climb the ladder and reach the next platform across the gap; Roto-Glide is the recommended option. Some walkthroughs describe a timed roll instead. Do not confuse this course with the park-side scaffold. The individual correspondence to original clues #20–21 remains unresolved.

steps.title: Restaurant Le Nah rooftop Screw #22
steps.instruction: Look behind the building immediately south of the restaurant for its ladder. Climb to the roof, follow the ledge and cross to the restaurant roof using a controlled roll or Roto-Glide. The published roof description matches the original #22 clue. The exact ladder base and landing remain unregistered.

steps.title: TM080 Iron Defense
steps.instruction: Find the separate building northeast of the Racine Construction block. Use the ladder on its northeastern side, then Roto-Glide onto the construction company's roof. Look for the golden TM pickup above the fast-travel area.

steps.title: TM074 Shadow Ball
steps.instruction: A second rooftop TM is reported overlooking Coulant Waterway near Wild Zone 17. Published routes use a ladder-accessible building to the northeast and Roto-Glide to the target roof. One guide lists this pickup under Rank C or higher; check story progression if it is unavailable. Do not assume the two TM approaches use the same physical ladder until verified.

steps.title: Optional Coulant Waterway approach
steps.instruction: For the separate canal-side Screw clue #16, start at Café Cyclone, go south down the steps and look beneath the bridge for the scaffold course. A published route uses ladders and a beam crossing. This is a boundary-area lead, not a new pickup or a surveyed connection from Racine's roof.

steps.title: Remaining map alignment
steps.instruction: The original #19–22 pickup markers have source-space coordinate references, but no calibrated Atlas entrances, scaffold bases or roof exits. The two TMs and waterway route also remain unregistered. No new permanent pin or collection checkbox has been added.

routes.title: Vert Sector 9 — Vernal Avenue lift, rooftop Screw and Power Gem
routes.description: Two published approaches to the original rooftop Screw #2, with a separate optional TM near Hotel Z. Our existing Vernal Avenue photographs show the ground lift, approximate map location and rooftop arrival. The precise roof-to-roof path and individual ladder endpoints are not registered.

steps.title: Locate the Vernal Avenue Holovator
steps.instruction: From Vernal Avenue, find the recessed grassy frontage immediately northwest of Wild Zone 1. Match the original ground photograph: golden arrows against a plain stone wall, a bench to the right and a green bin to the left. The existing approximate map point is for orientation, not an exact doorway.

steps.title: Complete Terra's Side Mission 23
steps.instruction: After the rival battle during Main Mission 10, speak to Terra. Examine the disturbed soil and defeat or catch the level 28 Diggersby. This restores the Holovator; the mission rewards include Soft Sand and a Revive.

steps.title: Reach the first roof
steps.instruction: Ride the repaired lift. The owner's rooftop-arrival photograph shows a green-grey roof surface, a higher sloping roof ahead and a visible ladder on a more distant building to the right. The photograph does not establish a safe crossing to that ladder or its exact endpoints.

steps.title: Rooftop Screw #2 — Holovator approach
steps.instruction: Published guides describe reaching the northeastern building complex of Vert Sector 9 from the lift beside Wild Zone 1, crossing roof sections and using Roto-Glide for the final gap. Look for the purple item ball. The pickup database also reports a Beedrill encounter nearby; prepare to deal with it if present. Roto-Glide unlocks during Main Mission 16.

steps.title: Alternative alley ladder
steps.instruction: Another guide describes a route through an alley blocked by purple sludge. Target the obstruction with a sufficiently strong Water-type move, or a compatible special Psychic-type move. Continue to the ladder, ascend, follow the rooftop left and use Roto-Glide to reach the next building. This is an alternative reported approach to the Screw, not an independently aligned ladder-to-lift connection.

steps.title: Optional TM019 Power Gem
steps.instruction: For the separate golden TM pickup, begin near Hotel Z. After learning Roto-Glide, follow the rooftop approach behind the hotel and glide west toward the smaller building west of the grassy square north of Hotel Z. Bring a ranged Pokémon move in case a web needs unfurling into a bridge. Guides disagree on the Vert 5/9 sector label; use landmarks rather than treating either label as an exact boundary. Do not count this as another Screw.

steps.title: Remaining alignment checks
steps.instruction: The original Screw #2 has a source-space pickup coordinate matched by marker link, not an Atlas pixel. The photographed neighbouring ladder, alternative alley ascent, exact roof exits and optional TM position still require physical registration. No new fixed pin or collection checkbox is claimed.

routes.title: Vert Sector 1 — plaza, canal scaffolds and courtyard
routes.description: Use the Centrico Plaza and Nouveau Café landmarks to orient yourself. These are separate optional courses, not a proven continuous route. Existing clues #10–13 keep their original numbers; exact matches between the source guides' numbering systems remain unresolved.

steps.title: Start near Nouveau Café and Centrico Plaza
steps.instruction: Face the tower-facing edge of Vert Sector 1. Published routes describe scaffolding near the plaza and another tall scaffold down a canal-side alley. Start at street level and identify the correct structure before climbing.

steps.title: Plaza-facing scaffold — clues #10–11 candidates
steps.instruction: Find the scaffold on the plaza-facing edge. Ascend its ladder, descend onto the next platform and follow the marked ramp towards the purple pickup. Our western and northern scaffold clues #10 and #11 are both candidates; do not mark both collected from one pickup.

steps.title: Canal-side alley scaffold
steps.instruction: From street level by the canal, look for the alley with a taller scaffold. Use the ladder on the right, cross the narrow platform, descend one level and cross the next walkway. A second source describes two scaffolds in this alley. The western/northern/eastern clues #10, #11 and #13 are not yet individually matched.

steps.title: Separate northern courtyard ladder
steps.instruction: A small courtyard in the northern building complex is reported behind breakable rocks. Clear the obstruction with a compatible move and climb its ladder. Guides report Protein and Pearl in this roof approach. A separate northern path ladder and scaffold crossing is also reported; do not assume it is this same ladder.

steps.title: Eastern enclosed courtyard — original clue #12
steps.instruction: After unlocking Roto-Glide, use the published scaffold approach near the Vert 1/3 boundary to reach the surrounding roofs. Look for the enclosed courtyard of the eastern building complex and descend into it. The purple pickup is reported in its western corner. The exact initial ascent and drop have not been registered.

steps.title: Keep boundary clues separate
steps.instruction: The eastern scaffold near Vert 3 may relate to original #13 or #14. Do not treat the courtyard, canal course and tower scaffold as one proven connection. Existing collection keys and map pins are unchanged; no exact ascent or pickup pixel is claimed.

routes.title: Vert Sector 2 — southern rooftop Screw
routes.description: A separately reported climb from the northern side leads toward the southern rooftop clue #9. Guides disagree about whether a running roll is sufficient before Roto-Glide; use the safer later-game approach if the early crossing does not work.

steps.title: Orient from Nouveau Café toward Wild Zone 2
steps.instruction: Follow Vert Street toward Wild Zone 2. A published approach turns right toward a stairway and passes through a courtyard to reach a ladder. The exact stairway and ladder base are not surveyed.

steps.title: Climb the northern ladder
steps.instruction: Use the reported northern ascent to reach the roof. Move along the roof toward the stacked brown crates and raised grey platform. Confirm the roof and crates are present before attempting the crossing.

steps.title: Cross to the southern roof — original clue #9
steps.instruction: Use Roto-Glide once unlocked during Main Mission 16. Two written guides also report a difficult running-roll crossing from the raised platform, but another lists Glide as required. Do not rely on a guaranteed early-game jump. Look for the purple pickup on the southern roof; Larvitar may be nearby.

steps.title: Check the landing and story gate
steps.instruction: The original clue #9 is preserved, but exact roof connection, earliest viable crossing and pickup pixel remain unverified. If the crossing fails, return with Roto-Glide. No new permanent marker is claimed.

routes.title: Vert Sector 3 — Café Cyclone roofs and boundary scaffolds
routes.description: Three reported pickup approaches around the Vert 1/3 boundary and Café Cyclone. Keep the existing photographed courtyard route as a separate starting reference. The original #13, #14 and #15 clues remain separate; source-number matches and exact roof connections are not confirmed.

steps.title: Orient at Café Cyclone and the Vert 1/3 boundary
steps.instruction: Start with the district map and Café Cyclone landmark beside Coulant Waterway. The boundary scaffold is a separate approach, not an extension of the photographed lift. Unlock Roto-Glide during Main Mission 16 before attempting the roof gaps.

steps.title: Boundary scaffolding — original #13–14 candidates
steps.instruction: Find the large scaffold east of the southern Vert Sector 1 building complex. Follow its ramps and ladders to the end of the platform, glide to the opposite section, then climb the final ladder to the purple pickup. Sources place the same climb on different sides of the Vert 1/3 boundary. Do not tick both original clues for this one pickup.

steps.title: Use the existing Café Cyclone photograph guide
steps.instruction: Return to street level and locate Café Cyclone. Open the linked original photograph gallery: pass through the broad covered arch, cross the grassy courtyard and find the gold-chevron Holovator on the far wall. The owner's six photographs support this approach and rooftop arrival; they do not establish the later scaffold connections.

steps.title: Published rooftop scaffold approach
steps.instruction: Separate published instructions describe clearing purple sludge at a courtyard approach with a suitable Water-type move, riding a lift and following a scaffold north of the roof. Ascend the platforms and cross to the right-hand pickup. Check the surroundings first; do not assume the photographed arch is blocked or that both reported entrances are the same. Bring Roto-Glide because sources disagree about the crossing requirement.

steps.title: Northern building rooftop — #14/#15 candidates
steps.instruction: A further reported route uses a platform near the top of the previous scaffold to reach the northern building. On that building, look for the small roof structure near the western or southwestern corner. Use Roto-Glide from the nearby blue roof rather than attempting an uncertain gap without it. Keep the original east-of-Wild-Zone-2 clue #15 separate from the west-rooftops clue #14. The physical connection and individual pickup identities are not yet matched.

steps.title: Keep rooftop and waterway clues distinct
steps.instruction: The Coulant Waterway scaffold is original clue #16, not another name for #15. Its existing separate directions remain available in the Vert Sector 6 course. No new permanent pin, floor plan, ladder location or collection key is claimed for these approaches. Return to the known street or lift if a roof crossing does not match the published landmarks.

routes.title: Vert Sector 8 — Hotel Z rooftop and riverside pickups
routes.description: Two separate published pickup approaches near Hotel Z. The hotel courtyard ladder is already owner-photographed; the exact riverside ladder identity and onward roof links are not measured. Do not combine these as one continuous route.

steps.title: Choose your Hotel Z route
steps.instruction: Start at Hotel Z, between Vert Street and Station Front. For the early scaffold pickup use the waterway behind the hotel. For the high eastern roof, wait until Roto-Glide is unlocked.

steps.title: Riverside course — climb from the waterway
steps.instruction: Find the published ladder beside the canal behind Hotel Z and climb onto the surrounding building. This may be a different ladder from the existing owner-photographed courtyard ladder.

steps.title: Riverside course — descend southeast
steps.instruction: From the roof head southeast to the scaffold attached to the building south of the waterway. Drop carefully down its levels toward the purple pickup. No Roto-Glide requirement is established for this particular course.

steps.title: Separate high-roof course — return to Hotel Z
steps.instruction: After unlocking Roto-Glide, use the rear ladder and glide to the adjoining roof as in the story tutorial. Climb the ladder onto the higher hotel roof and the next ladder to the right.

steps.title: High-roof course — blue roof crossings
steps.instruction: Look back along the approach, move left and glide to the higher blue roof. Follow its edge to the next roof gap, then glide toward the northeastern blue roof. Stop if the roof shape or height does not match the in-game surroundings.

steps.title: High-roof course — eastern tall building
steps.instruction: From the northeast roof of the hotel identify the taller building to the east. Descend onto its accessible approach and climb its final ladder to the rooftop purple pickup.

steps.title: Keep regional clues separate
steps.instruction: The two described courses are candidate matches for original district-only Screw clues #3 and #4, respectively. The exact pickup IDs, individual ladders and crossing coordinates are unresolved. Keep the original checkboxes and owner ladder route unchanged.

routes.title: Bleu Sector 1 / 3 — Wild Zone 5 and Sewer Entrance (Side Mission 57)
routes.description: Two alternative approaches to Hérup, who waits underground near the Wild Zone 5 / Bleu Sector 3 passage. Some sources assign his mission to Bleu 1 and others Bleu 3; both describe the same sewer access. Begin Main Mission 20 (after Rank D). No fixed entrance XY or underground floor plan is asserted.

steps.title: Choose the street or Wild Zone 5 entrance
steps.instruction: Activate guidance for Side Mission 57, The Camerupt Entrepreneur. The blue request icon can appear above an underground target; do not try to find Hérup on street level. Use either the Bleu Sector 3 alley route or the Wild Zone 5 route.

steps.title: Street approach — Bleu Sector 3 alley
steps.instruction: Look near Café Woof and the Bleu Sector 3 map label for the alley entrance to the underground path. Remove any purple sludge using a Water-type move, descend the path and turn left into the tunnel.

steps.title: Alternative approach — Wild Zone 5
steps.instruction: If approaching from Wild Zone 5, find its northwest sludge-blocked stairs. Wash away the sludge with a Water move and follow the waterway, clearing further sludge if necessary. Watch for the Alpha Whirlipede and take the southeast exit to the underground passage.

steps.title: Meet Hérup and open the gate
steps.instruction: Both approaches lead to Hérup at the sewer entrance. Speak to him to begin the request and open access. Enter the sewer once to register the Sewer Entrance fast-travel destination.

steps.title: Follow mission guidance and battle Camerupt
steps.instruction: Inside, the documented route takes the left branch and descends from a ledge, then turns right and takes the right fork. Follow active guidance to Hérup's room and defeat his level 46 Camerupt. Completion rewards: 4,500 Pokédollars, one Fire Stone and one Charcoal.

steps.title: Return to the city
steps.instruction: Use the registered Sewer Entrance fast-travel point, then turn back and climb the exit ladder. Litwick and Scraggy can be found underground.

steps.title: Access evidence and limits
steps.instruction: The two entrance descriptions agree on underground access but differ in sector naming. No measured stair, gate, item, room or exit coordinates are claimed, and no permanent moving Hyperspace marker is added.

routes.title: Bleu Sector 3 — Café Woof scaffold courses and Roto-Glide
routes.description: Two separate scaffold pickups around Vernal Avenue and Café Woof. The original south and northeast clues #55 and #56 are retained as candidates; these are published written approaches, not an exact entrance or measured crossing. The existing Side Mission 61 photographs are a separate landmark reference.

steps.title: Start between Café Woof and Aymlis Park
steps.instruction: Use Vernal Avenue and Café Woof to orient yourself east of Bleu Plaza and north of Aymlis Park. Locate the southern scaffold course first if Roto-Glide is still locked. Do not confuse the raised platforms with the sewer entrance from Side Mission 57.

steps.title: Southern course — early pickup
steps.instruction: Find the scaffold along the southern side of the sector. Follow its stairs and ladder towards the red item ball. From that level, line up with the neighbouring platform, roll across, then follow the remaining climb to the purple pickup. A separate location list describes the eastern building alcove here; #55 is a likely match, not a certified ID.

steps.title: Northeast course — return with Roto-Glide
steps.instruction: The other pickup lies on the northeast scaffolding, north of Café Woof. Return after unlocking Roto-Glide in Main Mission 16. A published alternative starts outside Wild Zone 5 and approaches the scaffolds via the adjacent streets. Use the visible structures, not a guessed street turn.

steps.title: Northeast course — cross the platform gap
steps.instruction: Climb to the upper part of the first scaffold, face the adjacent structure and use Roto-Glide to reach it. Look for the purple pickup on the receiving scaffold; the northeast listing also records a Shiny Stone in that area. #56 remains a candidate until individual pickup identity is checked.

steps.title: Nearby owner-photographed Holovator
steps.instruction: The five photographs linked below show the separate golden Holovator west of Café Woof for Side Mission 61. Use these to recognise the neighbourhood; neither the photographs nor this route prove a direct crossing between its roof and either scaffold.

steps.title: Evidence and return
steps.instruction: Keep #55 and #56 in the existing Item Atlas checklist. The two courses and relative directions are supported by published guides; their precise ladder bases, landings and Atlas map pixels are not registered. If the geometry differs, return to street level and use the original sector photograph.

routes.title: Bleu Sector 5 — Bleu Plaza scaffolds and western rooftop
routes.description: Separate platforming and rooftop approaches west of Aymlis Park. The saved #57–59 regional clues stay unchanged. Published guides disagree over how many pickups are assigned to this sector versus nearby areas; no new Screw number or exact rooftop connection is asserted.

steps.title: Orient at Bleu Plaza
steps.instruction: From Bleu Plaza, find the large scaffold area to the southwest, between Bleu Street and Aymlis Park. The Nouveau Café truck near Sector 7 is a useful southern landmark. Use the original sector image to distinguish the park from the western building block.

steps.title: First scaffold pickup
steps.instruction: Approach the large course from its right-hand side as described by Raider King. Follow the ramps and climb the ladder to the upper platform. Look for the purple Screw pickup; do not yet assign it to #57 or #58.

steps.title: Second scaffold pickup
steps.instruction: From the upper platform, aim a controlled roll toward the adjacent reachable scaffold. Continue up the second structure to look for its pickup. Independent inventories list scaffold finds near Bleu Plaza and Bleu Street, but their numbering and grouping do not establish the original two IDs.

steps.title: Separate roof approach — waterway
steps.instruction: Return to street level for the separate rooftop search. One published route starts at the small waterway southeast of the large course, where Magikarp can be seen. Look for the ice obstacle and activate it with an appropriate move to form a crossing. Continue along the accessible approach rather than assuming the scaffold route connects directly.

steps.title: Western building rooftop
steps.instruction: Search the accessible western building roof for the purple pickup. Independent sector notes also list Zinc on this roof. The published waterway approach and another approach via the Side Mission 61 Holovator are route leads, not a measured equivalence. The existing #59 rooftop clue is a candidate only.

steps.title: Optional Holovator reference
steps.instruction: The owner-photographed lift west of Café Woof has its own five-image guide. StrategyWiki describes a route from that lift towards the Wild Zone 12 barrier and another ladder after Side Mission 61. Follow this only if the visible roof layout matches; the Atlas has not surveyed that connection.

steps.title: Keep collection records separate
steps.instruction: Use the three existing #57–59 collection entries. Some external inventories assign additional nearby scaffolds or boundary pickups to Bleu Sector 5. Do not create or tick a fourth item, infer a continuous route, or assume the exact crosswalk until the individual locations are checked.

routes.title: Bleu Sector 2 — Wild Zone 5 roof and waterway sweep
routes.description: Three separate approaches: the northwestern roof, eastern courtyard and rooftop, and the underground waterway. Use this guide with the existing Wild Zone 5 and Bleu Sector 2 maps and saved item records. These are not measured roof-to-roof connections.

steps.title: Find Wild Zone 5
steps.instruction: Orient from Café Gallant, southwest of Centrico Plaza. Wild Zone 5 covers parts of Bleu Sectors 1 and 2 and Bleu Street. Use the open in-game gate and the existing Wild Zone 5 map. Do not confuse the zone entrance with the separate story sewer entrance.

steps.title: Sweep the ground-level paths
steps.instruction: Search the open western grass and the buildings around it before climbing. Published inventories describe a Revive in the grassy area and a Great Ball near the adjoining building. Check the northwest stairwell and waterway for additional healing items; keep the original item IDs until each is individually matched.

steps.title: Northwestern ladder — Abra and rooftop items
steps.instruction: Go to the northwest corner of the zone, look for the ladder on the building, and climb to the western rooftop. This is a useful search area for Abra and Electrike. Look around the lower roof for a Pearl and the upper roof for a Leaf Stone; a Fire move such as Ember is reported for the Leaf Stone obstacle.

steps.title: Return for upper pickups
steps.instruction: Inspect the northwestern rooftops for a Full Heal and Great Ball. A higher Great Ball and a Timer Ball on a market stall are reported as Roto-Glide pickups. If your story has not unlocked Roto-Glide, leave these for a later visit instead of forcing a jump.

steps.title: Separate eastern approach — waterway
steps.instruction: Return to ground level and locate the blocked waterway in the northeastern part of Wild Zone 5. Clear the purple sludge with a Water-type attack, then clear the next obstruction below and follow the tunnel. An Alpha Whirlipede can be encountered beyond it; prepare to evade or catch it rather than assume the path is safe.

steps.title: Eastern rooftop — TM040 Bullet Seed
steps.instruction: Near the Whirlipede and sewer approach, look for ladders leading onto the neighbouring eastern roofs. Follow accessible ladders toward the southern entrance and inspect the roof edge for the gold TM040 Bullet Seed pickup. Search the roofs for Electrike and Pidgeotto. Do not assume a crossing to the northwestern roof exists.

steps.title: Finish the item checklist
steps.instruction: The original Bleu Sector 2 list has ten named item leads, #05-17 to #05-26. Some sources describe their surrounding Wild Zone 5 instead of a numbered sector. Use the existing Item Atlas checkmarks only after finding the item; neither the exact ID crosswalk nor all ladder positions are confirmed.

routes.title: Bleu Sector 6 — southwest plaza scaffold and eastern roof
routes.description: The paired Screw pickups on the western scaffold are distinguished from the separate rooftop pickup overlooking the Rust Syndicate neighbourhood. Existing #62 and #63 describe the lower and upper tiers. The rooftop lead remains unnumbered here.

steps.title: Find the small park southwest of Bleu Plaza
steps.instruction: Use the Bleu Plaza and Bleu Sector 6 source map for orientation. Find the large western scaffold course in the small park southwest of the plaza. A route from Café Soleil approaches via adjoining streets, but start at the visible park if possible.

steps.title: Reach the first upper platform
steps.instruction: Follow the scaffold ramps and steps from the side with the accessible climb. Reach the upper part of the first structure and line up with the neighbouring platform. Published guides describe a controlled roll across this gap; do not jump toward an unconfirmed roof.

steps.title: Collect the lower-tier Screw clue #62
steps.instruction: After reaching the adjacent scaffold, inspect the sheltered area around its staircase and crates for the purple pickup. This fits the saved partway-up #62 description; check the actual item before marking the existing record.

steps.title: Climb higher for Screw clue #63
steps.instruction: Continue up the stairs and ladder to the higher platform. Check the upper tier for a second purple pickup. This fits #63. A Sun Stone is also reported on the western scaffold, but its exact position and the existing item ID are not established.

steps.title: Optional eastern rooftop search
steps.instruction: A separate published route uses the higher ladder and the glazed arcade roof, followed by another ladder onto the eastern building. Look around the upper roof facing the plaza and Rust Syndicate Office for another Screw and a reported Moon Stone. Do not assume this is the same as the Sector 4 pickup.

steps.title: Keep the existing records
steps.instruction: The two scaffold tiers match the regional #62/#63 clues. The rooftop location is supported, but its correspondence to the district-level #60 or #61 records is unresolved. There is no new collection ID, exact scaffold base, calibrated roof exit or measured map pin.

routes.title: Bleu Sector 4 — southern roof via Bleu Sector 6
routes.description: Cross-checked rooftop approach from the Sector 6 scaffold. A separate western-roof group of evolution stones is reported, but its entrance has not been matched to this approach. No new Screw or item IDs.

steps.title: Start at Bleu Plaza, west side
steps.instruction: Bleu Sector 4 lies west of Bleu Plaza. Its source crop identifies the sector but does not establish an exact ladder. For the southern-roof Screw, start with the Sector 6 western scaffold course instead of looking for an unverified street entrance in Sector 4.

steps.title: Use the Sector 6 scaffold approach
steps.instruction: Follow the written Bleu Sector 6 route through the two scaffold tiers and reach the roof above the course. Treat any return to street level as a separate approach; do not assume the other Sector 6 roof reaches the same target.

steps.title: Continue toward the taller building
steps.instruction: At roof level, follow the accessible path toward the tall southern building in Sector 4. Published descriptions agree on using a ladder from the Sector 6 roof approach. Check that the visible path and ladders match before continuing.

steps.title: Climb and search the lower eastern roof
steps.instruction: Use the ladder to reach the higher part, then look down toward the east for the lower roof with the purple pickup. Drop only when the lower surface is visible and within reach. This is the reported Sector 4 Screw, not either of the two Sector 6 scaffold pickups.

steps.title: Separate western-roof item leads
steps.instruction: Published inventories report Sun Stone, Ice Stone and Water Stone on the western building roofs. These are useful return targets but their access course has not been established. Do not present them as guaranteed pickups along the southern-roof route.

steps.title: Unresolved collection crosswalk
steps.instruction: The original numbered-sector list contains no explicitly assigned Screw for Bleu Sector 4, whereas district-level clues #60 and #61 describe rooftops near Wild Zone 16 and the Rust Syndicate Office. Preserve the existing 100-entry checklist; do not create a new number or tick a candidate automatically. Exact entrances, roof geometry and item crosswalk remain unverified.

routes.title: Bleu Sector 7 — Aymlis Park roofs and boulevard scaffolds
routes.description: Four distinct search courses around Aymlis Park, the eastern and western building blocks and South Boulevard. Use the existing sector map and separate five-photo South Boulevard Holovator gallery. Existing collection numbers are candidates, not measured pickup positions.

steps.title: Start at Bleu Pokémon Center
steps.instruction: Find Bleu Pokémon Center, then use the Aymlis Park and South Boulevard labels on the original map to distinguish the northern building approach from the outer-boulevard courses.

steps.title: Northern scaffold and rooftop loop
steps.instruction: South of Aymlis Park, inspect the scaffolding at the northern side of the building. Climb its ramps and ladders, then cross to the neighbouring scaffold with a controlled roll if the platform is reachable. A separate published roof approach follows the building perimeter anticlockwise. Check the visible roof path; #52 and #53 are candidate clues, not a confirmed order.

steps.title: Ladders near Nouveau Café Truck No. 2
steps.instruction: Return to the southern frontage near Nouveau Café Truck No. 2. Look east of the truck for the two-ladder approach described by a published guide. Climb both, then descend to the lower level with the purple pickup if visible. Follow the accessible roof perimeter for a separate pickup. The east and west roof identity crosswalk is still unresolved.

steps.title: Eastern roof and Vernal Avenue
steps.instruction: For the eastern building block, use a visibly connected roof or Roto-Glide after the rooftop tutorial behind Hotel Z, around Main Missions 15–16. Inspect the northeastern edge. Return to street level to find the separate Vernal Avenue scaffold; follow its walkways to the end. #48 and #49 describe eastern scaffold and roof leads; do not tick either on sight of a different pickup.

steps.title: Two outer-boulevard pickups
steps.instruction: Return to South Boulevard below Sector 7. Find the larger roadside scaffold course. Use the right-hand ladders to reach the upper path, traverse its three connecting bridges, then look for the upper pickup. A lower pickup is reported off the side; inspect the platform before dropping. The original #50 and #51 west-of-lab height clues are possible matches, not confirmed IDs.

steps.title: Optional repaired lift — Mission 45
steps.instruction: The existing Bleu 7 South Boulevard lift guide has five owner photographs. After starting Main Mission 19, talk to Durstin and give him a drink such as Fresh Water or Lemonade to restore the Holovator. Use the separately documented lift route rather than treating it as a proven shortcut to any of these Screw pickups.

steps.title: Keep the six original clues separate
steps.instruction: Retain #48–53 and the original item checklist. The regional inventories use different numbering and boundaries. Exact scaffold bases, roof junctions, lift-to-pickup connections and individual collection matches remain unverified.

routes.title: Bleu Sector 8 — Café Soleil and the Beldum Blockade
routes.description: Use the photographed gold Holovator as a neighbourhood landmark and the in-game quest marker to locate the actual Beldum Blockade. The physical identity of the photographed lift and the mission lift has not been established.

steps.title: Orient from Café Soleil
steps.instruction: Use the Bleu Sector 8 map crop and start at Café Soleil on the South Boulevard side. Follow the outer boulevard toward the southwest frontage of Sector 8.

steps.title: Compare the five owner photographs
steps.instruction: Look for the permanent gold triple-chevron lift near blue-glass windows and the roadside grass strip. Open the existing Café Soleil gallery to compare its approach and arrival. A photograph of this device is not proof that it is the Mission 92 device.

steps.title: Find Aimant and the Beldum quest marker
steps.instruction: After completing Main Mission 30 and beginning Main Mission 31, locate Side Mission 92, The Beldum Blockade, on South Boulevard. Follow the in-game objective marker to Aimant and the four Beldum, even if it points to a different lift from the photographed one.

steps.title: Clear the blockade
steps.instruction: Defeat the four Beldum. A Ground-type area attack is a useful option against their Steel typing. Complete the dialogue and use the mission-confirmed Holovator only once access is restored. Rewards include the Rocky Helmet and Full Restore.

steps.title: Use the arrival as orientation only
steps.instruction: Compare the roof arrival with the existing photo gallery if the device matches in game. The precise mission device, rooftop connection and any linked item pickup are not individually verified. No new roof pin or collection ID is assigned.

routes.title: Bleu Sector 9 — Café Soleil scaffold and roof items
routes.description: A distinct scaffold opposite Café Soleil and separate courtyard/roof item leads around the Sector 9 building complex. The existing Sector 8 lift photographs are nearby orientation only.

steps.title: Find Café Soleil
steps.instruction: Use the source map showing Café Soleil just south of Sector 9 and South Boulevard to the west. Locate the climbing structure on the opposite side of the boulevard, rather than the lift along Sector 8.

steps.title: Climb the roadside scaffold
steps.instruction: Begin at the left-hand end of the scaffold as viewed from its approach. Climb the visible ramps or ladders to its high walkway. Walk carefully over the narrow connecting bridge.

steps.title: Use Roto-Glide for the upper platform
steps.instruction: From the high walkway, glide to the raised platform when the landing is visible, then use the final ladder on the right. If Roto-Glide is not unlocked, return after the rooftop Roto-Glide tutorial behind Hotel Z during the Main Mission 15–16 sequence. Do not rely on an unintended wall-clipping shortcut.

steps.title: Find the purple pickup opposite the café
steps.instruction: Inspect the top for the Colourful Screw. Its landmark matches the existing #64 clue, but check the actual pickup before ticking. The map location remains district-level.

steps.title: Separate courtyard and roof item search
steps.instruction: On returning to the Sector 9 complex, the published item inventory places Protein in its courtyard, Carbos on Café Soleil's roof, Calcium and Ultra Ball on eastern roofs, Leaf Stone on a western roof and Exp. Candy M to the north. Use only visible, accessible ladders or an unlocked lift; the approach to each item has not been matched.

steps.title: Preserve the original collection records
steps.instruction: The photographed Sector 8 lift is not a certified connection to these roofs or the opposite scaffold. #64 is retained as the matching regional clue; no exact entrance, new pickup ID or mapped roof connection has been established.

routes.title: Bleu Sector 10 — Estival Avenue lower scaffold
routes.description: An outer-boulevard scaffold west of Sector 10, near the Estival Avenue junction. The lower pickup is hidden beneath the walkway, not at the highest point.

steps.title: Find the Estival Avenue junction
steps.instruction: Use the original Sector 10 map: Estival Avenue lies to the north, South Boulevard to the west and Espace Vide to the east. Head toward the South Boulevard junction and look for the scaffold on the outer street.

steps.title: Climb the accessible end
steps.instruction: Start on the right-hand climbing side described in the published route, then cross the upper walkway until you can see the lower platform at the far end.

steps.title: Descend to the lower walkway
steps.instruction: Walk carefully off the upper edge onto the visible lower platform; follow the ramp beneath the main scaffold instead of trying to reach its highest point.

steps.title: Search under the scaffold
steps.instruction: Look beneath the upper walkway for the purple pickup. Independent sources describe the lower scaffold west of Wild Zone 10 and near the Estival Avenue/South Boulevard corner. This is consistent with the existing #65 clue.

steps.title: Confirm before ticking #65
steps.instruction: The source crop identifies the district only, not the exact scaffold base or pickup point. Keep the existing #65 collection record and do not create another number or claim a measured pin.

routes.title: Rouge Sector 2 — Galerie de la Lune roof
routes.description: A scaffold-and-ladder approach to the gallery roof and its Toxic TM.

steps.title: Find the gallery
steps.instruction: Start near Centrico Pokémon Center and locate Galerie de la Lune in Rouge Sector 2.

steps.title: Reach the roof ladder
steps.instruction: PokéJungle describes reaching the exterior roof ladder through a scaffolding course. Follow the visible scaffold connections to that ladder.

steps.title: Search the northern roof
steps.instruction: Climb onto the roof and inspect its northern part for TM007 Toxic, as listed in the sector guide.

steps.title: Check the next connection
steps.instruction: The scaffold entrance and each intervening platform are not measured in Atlas. Confirm the visible ladder and landing before moving beyond this approach.

routes.title: Rouge Sector 3 — North Boulevard roof approach
routes.description: Use the preserved North Boulevard lift photographs to orient a written approach toward the Sector 3 rooftops.

steps.title: Compare the boulevard frontage
steps.instruction: Open the North Boulevard / Rouge Sector 3 photographs. The retained approach uses Wild Zones 18 and 13 as bearings for the inner building frontage.

steps.title: Recognize the arrival
steps.instruction: The original gallery shows the gold lift at street level and a tiled rooftop arrival. Compare those views when choosing the lift.

steps.title: Continue toward Sector 3
steps.instruction: Raider King describes returning toward Sector 3 from the North Boulevard lift. The independent sector list places a Colorful Screw on the middle building complex’s roof.

steps.title: Check onward roof links
steps.instruction: The photographs establish a local arrival, not a continuous route to every adjoining roof. Follow only connections visible in-game; the final roof connection remains unmeasured.

routes.title: Rouge Sector 4 — Passage Ombragé roof
routes.description: Find the arcade’s exterior ladder and inspect the glass-covered middle of its roof.

steps.title: Find Passage Ombragé
steps.instruction: Locate the shopping arcade in Rouge Sector 4, between the Sector 3 and Sector 5 approaches.

steps.title: Find an exterior ladder
steps.instruction: Written sources describe ladder access but differ on the side: Altissimo records access from Sector 7, while Raider King names a southern corner. Identify the actual ladder in-game.

steps.title: Inspect the glass roof
steps.instruction: Once above the arcade, search the central skylight area. Altissimo and Gamer Guides both place a Colorful Screw on this roof.

steps.title: Keep the entrance distinction
steps.instruction: A particular ladder side and a measured entrance have not been reconciled. The district map does not establish which roof edge is a safe return route.

routes.title: Rouge Sector 5 — Looker Bureau roof approach
routes.description: Start with the existing Looker Bureau / Sushi High Roller lift gallery, then compare the published rooftop approach.

steps.title: Approach from Rouge Plaza
steps.instruction: Use the original gallery to find the lift across the short street from Sushi High Roller, on the Looker Bureau side south of Dormez Bien Cemetery.

steps.title: Compare the photographed landing
steps.instruction: Ride the visible lift and compare the original rooftop arrival image before continuing.

steps.title: Inspect the higher northern roof
steps.instruction: Raider King describes a roll from the northern high roof toward Looker Bureau’s roof. The sector guide independently records a screw on the western building complex.

steps.title: Check the gap first
steps.instruction: The photographs do not document that complete jump. Confirm the target roof and landing in-game; there is no measured jump line or return connection here.

routes.title: Rouge Sector 6 — Ampharos roof and Toxic Spikes
routes.description: Follow the Main Mission 23 roof approach through the lower scaffolding; Toxic Spikes lies along the documented route.

steps.title: Approach the mission lift
steps.instruction: During Main Mission 23, head northwest from Hibernal Pokémon Center toward Naveen at the objective Holovator.

steps.title: Complete the street encounter
steps.instruction: Complete Gwynn’s battle in that mission, then use the Holovator. The nearby original lift photographs provide additional street and roof orientation.

steps.title: Follow the lower roof course
steps.instruction: Thonky describes crossing scaffolding on a lower part of the roof and continuing along the rooftops to TM089 Toxic Spikes. The sector table independently lists that TM on the northern building complex.

steps.title: Confirm the next ascent
steps.instruction: The later lower-roof drop and ladder lead toward the Ampharos objective during the mission. Exact landings and the owner-photo device match are not independently registered.

routes.title: Rouge Sector 7 — Apartment block ladder (#65)
routes.description: A useful ladder approach from the battle-court area to the apartment roof in Side Mission 65.

steps.title: Find the apartment request
steps.instruction: Look south of Wild Zone 13 for the battle-court area. Altissimo places Ante west of that court; Side Mission 65 becomes available during the Main Mission 20 sequence.

steps.title: Climb beside Ante
steps.instruction: Thonky directs you up the ladder near Ante to reach the apartment roof.

steps.title: Follow the rooftop objective
steps.instruction: During Side Mission 65, follow the Dedenne objective around the roof. The encounter belongs to the mission and is not a catchable ordinary spawn.

steps.title: Keep other roofs separate
steps.instruction: This approach establishes one apartment-roof entry. The separate scaffold courses and nearby roofs still need individual connection and return-path checks.

routes.title: Rouge Sector 8 — Western courtyard scaffolds
routes.description: Use the two courtyard blocks beside Hibernal Avenue to distinguish the scaffold course from the surrounding rooftops.

steps.title: Identify the courtyard blocks
steps.instruction: Compare the original Sector 8 crop: two enclosed building blocks sit west of Hibernal Avenue. The written item list distinguishes their courtyards.

steps.title: Find the western course
steps.instruction: The published course begins at a ladder on the northern side inside the western courtyard. Check the visible courtyard access before climbing.

steps.title: Use Roto-Glide for upper platforms
steps.instruction: The source tables mark the upper screw platforms as requiring Roto-Glide. Build height using the scaffold ladders, then compare each visible landing before crossing.

steps.title: Treat further roofs as separate
steps.instruction: The sector also has courses and roofs beyond this courtyard. Their entrances, floor heights and continuous links are not fully recorded here.

routes.title: Jaune Sector 1 — Jaune Street park (#11)
routes.description: A ground-level approach to Montée in the grassy area north of Jaune Street.

steps.title: Head east from Centrico
steps.instruction: From Centrico Pokémon Center, head east toward the grassy Jaune Sector 1 area northeast of Prism Tower.

steps.title: Use the park paths
steps.instruction: The original crop shows Jaune Street beside the park paths. The sector guide places Montée under the central tree.

steps.title: Find The Kakuna Master
steps.instruction: After Main Mission 7 begins, speak to Montée for Side Mission 11. This request is in Jaune Sector 1.

steps.title: Use the image for orientation
steps.instruction: The crop identifies the park approach, not an exact NPC coordinate or a complete entrance survey. Follow the visible paths to the requester.

routes.title: Jaune Sector 2 — Justice Dojo western courtyard
routes.description: Use the rooftop ladder west of Justice Dojo to inspect the enclosed Sector 2 courtyard from above.

steps.title: Start west of Justice Dojo
steps.instruction: Find Jaune Sector 2 west of Justice Dojo, above Saison Canalside on the original district crop.

steps.title: Climb the nearby roof ladder
steps.instruction: DualShockers independently describes a ladder west of the dojo leading to these rooftops.

steps.title: Inspect the inner garden
steps.instruction: The written screw route descends from this rooftop into the inner garden. Altissimo independently places a screw in the enclosed western courtyard.

steps.title: Check the landing and exit
steps.instruction: Inspect the garden below before dropping. A measured landing and a continuous return path have not been documented, so the map crop alone cannot confirm them.

routes.title: Jaune Sector 3 — Camerupt scaffold approach
routes.description: The documented Main Mission 12 ladder course reaches the northern building’s roof.

steps.title: Find the northern building
steps.instruction: Use Jaune Plaza and the original Sector 3 crop as bearings. The published course is south of the sector’s northern building.

steps.title: Follow the Main Mission 12 objective
steps.instruction: During Main Mission 12, meet Tarragon near Restaurant Le Wow, between Centrico and Hibernal Pokémon Centers. Complete the required battle before using the blocked course.

steps.title: Climb the ladder course
steps.instruction: Thonky describes a Zinc and Colorful Screw along the ascent. Keep climbing the visible ladders toward the Camerupt roof; Altissimo independently lists those scaffold pickups.

steps.title: Separate the southern roof
steps.instruction: Other Sector 3 roofs require a different approach, including Roto-Glide for the southern roof in the item table. This course does not verify every roof connection.

routes.title: Jaune Sector 4 — Hibernal Avenue roof and scaffold
routes.description: Compare the original Hibernal Avenue lift photographs, then inspect the scaffold below the roof.

steps.title: Find the photographed lift
steps.instruction: From Hibernal Pokémon Center, follow the retained southwest approach along Hibernal Avenue. Compare the gold arrows beside the blue windows in the original gallery.

steps.title: Compare the arrival image
steps.instruction: Use the lift and compare the broad tiled rooftop shown in the original photograph.

steps.title: Inspect the avenue-side scaffold
steps.instruction: The Hibernal Avenue item list places a screw on the Sector 4 scaffold accessible from the roof. The independent walkthrough also describes descending to it from the lift’s roof.

steps.title: Confirm a visible platform
steps.instruction: The exact drop and scaffold landing are not measured. Do not treat a neighboring roof or the web visible in the arrival photograph as a certified connection.

routes.title: Jaune Sector 5 — Western enclosed courtyard
routes.description: A published roof approach reaches the small courtyard in the western building complex.

steps.title: Use Jaune Plaza as the bearing
steps.instruction: The original Sector 5 image shows the area north of Jaune Plaza and west of Wild Zone 19. Find the small western building complex in that view.

steps.title: Approach from Hibernal Avenue
steps.instruction: Raider King describes taking the Sector 4 Hibernal lift, then continuing southeast toward Sector 5. The existing Sector 4 gallery provides orientation for the starting area.

steps.title: Look into the enclosed courtyard
steps.instruction: The sector list places a Colorful Screw inside this small western courtyard. Inspect the garden below from the roof before following the published descent.

steps.title: Check the return route
steps.instruction: The written roof-to-garden approach is not a measured chain of roof connections. Exact drops and exits remain unknown; the photographs show only the nearby lift arrival.

routes.title: Jaune Sector 7 — Café Kizuna scaffold / Hyper Beam
routes.description: One documented approach uses the Hibernal Avenue mission lift to reach the courtyard scaffolding behind Café Kizuna.

steps.title: Find the Hibernal mission lift
steps.instruction: From Hibernal Pokémon Center, head northeast toward Amordél’s blocked Holovator. Side Mission 80 appears during Main Mission 26; follow its objective if the lift is still blocked.

steps.title: Open this approach
steps.instruction: Complete Side Mission 80 to clear the Pokémon blocking this lift. Have Roto-Glide available before attempting the courtyard platforms.

steps.title: Approach the courtyard from the roof
steps.instruction: The TM walkthrough approaches the inner garden behind Café Kizuna from the lift north of the café. Gamer Guides identifies the southern rooftop as the approach to the central scaffolding.

steps.title: Reach the central platform
steps.instruction: Use a visible scaffold platform to line up a roll and Roto-Glide onto the central scaffold for TM044 Hyper Beam. The sector table independently confirms this placement and the glide requirement.

steps.title: Keep the photo identity qualified
steps.instruction: The existing Hibernal Avenue gallery is useful for orientation. It does not certify that its lift is the mission-80 device or document every roof and platform connection.

routes.title: Jaune Sector 8 — Froakie’s first scaffold courses (#9)
routes.description: Start near Jaune Pokémon Center and follow Surv’s timed scaffold challenges; the final course is in another district.

steps.title: Meet Surv north of the Center
steps.instruction: After Main Mission 6 begins, look north of Jaune Pokémon Center near the grassy North Boulevard area for Surv’s Side Mission 9.

steps.title: Complete the first ascent
steps.instruction: The first course has a 30-second limit. Run up the slopes, climb the ladder, and take care on the narrow walkway.

steps.title: Follow the second objective
steps.instruction: Speak to Surv at the next objective for the 40-second course. Slow down on its narrow upper walkways if needed.

steps.title: Return for the final course with Roto-Glide
steps.instruction: The final 50-second course is farther north near Rouge Pokémon Center, not wholly inside Jaune Sector 8. Thonky requires Roto-Glide for that stage.

steps.title: Follow the current course marker
steps.instruction: This guide records the starting approach and stage distinction. It does not register every obstacle, jump or later-course entrance on the district map.

routes.title: Jaune Sector 9 — Jaune Street courtyard
routes.description: A ground approach between the northern buildings reaches the Main Mission 18 courtyard.

steps.title: Start at Jaune Pokémon Center
steps.instruction: During Main Mission 18, leave Jaune Pokémon Center toward the southwest and follow the objective toward Sector 9.

steps.title: Go between the buildings
steps.instruction: Thonky directs you between the buildings to Naveen. Altissimo identifies the destination as the courtyard between the two small buildings along Jaune Street.

steps.title: Meet the courtyard objective
steps.instruction: Stay with the mission marker for the Rogue Mega Banette encounter. This ground-level courtyard is separate from the City Hall and scaffold roof pickups.

steps.title: Keep the rooftop leads separate
steps.instruction: The shared Sector 9–12 map is an orientation image. It does not establish an entrance or ladder to every City Hall and neighboring roof.

routes.title: Jaune Sector 11 — Jaune Street lift and southern roof
routes.description: Use the existing Jaune Street lift gallery, then inspect the written Roto-Glide approach toward the southern roofs.

steps.title: Find the raised terrace
steps.instruction: From Jaune Plaza, follow Jaune Street toward North Boulevard. Compare the original lift photograph: a raised stone terrace sits against a grey building beside a blond trainer.

steps.title: Compare the arrival view
steps.instruction: Use the visible lift and compare the original wide tiled rooftop arrival.

steps.title: Inspect the southern transfer
steps.instruction: The written route continues south and uses a roll with Roto-Glide to reach the higher roof. Independent item lists place a screw on the southern Sector 11 building complex.

steps.title: Check each landing
steps.instruction: The owner gallery shows the arrival, not that full crossing. Confirm the target and landing in-game; do not merge the separate roof pickups or invent a measured jump line.
